Guidelines and Data
Club Guidelines
Account and Membership Data

Signing in sends your email and sign-in details to the club service. Claiming a card sends your nickname and the guidelines version. The server stores your card number, join date and membership status.
Workout, water, sleep and body records stay on this device only. Claiming a card doesn’t upload them.

The sign-in token is encrypted with a key in the Android Keystore and stored on this device. Signing out clears the sign-in data and the cached membership on this device. It doesn’t delete your account or your membership on the server.
Share images contain your nickname and join date. The card number is hidden by default, and you can turn it on in the preview. Nothing is uploaded or shared until you confirm.
What the Card Is Not
The free member card records your club membership. It grants no paid benefits and can’t be used for payment or gym entry. Images are keepsake copies only. The server decides your membership status.

After signing in, delete your account in Account and Security. After email confirmation, your account and membership data are deleted from the server. Local records are kept. If you cannot sign in, contact privacy@leanmuscle.club.
